text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Pendidikan

(Penggal Institusi Pendidikan Tahun 2027) 2026.

Pemakaian

2. Peraturan-Peraturan ini hendaklah terpakai bagi kehadiran di institusi

pendidikan kecuali di sekolah swasta, sekolah ekspatriat dan sekolah antarabangsa

bagi tahun 2027.

Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan

3. Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan bagi tahun 2027 adalah sebagaimana

yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Kumpulan A

Semua institusi pendidikan di Kedah,

Kelantan dan Terengganu

Penggal Pertama

4 Januari 2027 hingga 4 Mac 2027

14 Mac 2027 hingga 20 Mei 2027

Penggal Kedua

6 Jun 2027 hingga 26 Ogos 2027

5 September 2027 hingga 2 Disember 2027

Kumpulan B

Semua institusi pendidikan di Johor,

Melaka, Negeri Sembilan, Pahang,

Perak, Perlis, Pulau Pinang, Sabah,

Sarawak, Selangor, Wilayah

Persekutuan Kuala Lumpur, Wilayah

Persekutuan Labuan dan Wilayah

Persekutuan Putrajaya

Penggal Pertama

4 Januari 2027 hingga 5 Mac 2027

15 Mac 2027 hingga 21 Mei 2027

Penggal Kedua

7 Jun 2027 hingga 27 Ogos 2027

6 September 2027 hingga 3 Disember 2027

Dibuat 1 Oktober 2026

[KPM.PUU.S.100-1/19/8 JLD.2(4); PN(PU2)569/JLD.16]

FADHLINA BINTI SIDEK

Menteri Pendidikan

EDUCATION ACT 1996

EDUCATION (TERMS OF EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS YEAR 2027)

REGULATIONS 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 130(2)(b) of the Education Act 1996

[Act 550], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Education (Terms of Educational

Institutions Year 2027) Regulations 2026.

Application

2. These Regulations shall apply to attendance at educational institutions except

at private schools, expatriate schools and international schools for the year 2027.

Duration of terms of educational institutions

3. The duration of terms of educational institutions for the year 2027 shall be

as specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Group A

All educational institutions in Kedah,

Kelantan and Terengganu

First Term

4 January 2027 to 4 March 2027

14 March 2027 to 20 May 2027

Second Term

6 June 2027 to 26 August 2027

5 September 2027 to 2 December 2027

Group B

All educational institutions in Johore,

Malacca, Negeri Sembilan, Pahang,

Perak, Perlis, Penang, Sabah,

Sarawak, Selangor, Federal Territory

of Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory

of Labuan and Federal Territory

of Putrajaya

First Term

4 January 2027 to 5 March 2027

15 March 2027 to 21 May 2027

Second Term

7 June 2027 to 27 August 2027

6 September 2027 to 3 December 2027

Made 1 October 2026

[KPM.PUU.S.100-1/19/8 JLD.2(4); PN(PU2)569/JLD.16]

FADHLINA BINTI SIDEK

Minister of Education
